How to use the collection

Try the new additions or the design shortlist. Save examples with the star, then compare how they introduce the author, arrange research projects, and present publications. Open “Source and verification” on a card to see the lab page and discovery trail. “Website source code” links to the matched public repository; general GitHub profiles are labeled separately.

Institution counts and review method

Personal links were discovered through university labs and research groups, sometimes through a lab member profile. Graduate affiliation and rendered desktop appearance were checked. Some students have moved universities since their original lab listing; their current affiliation is shown. Public pages can become outdated. Checked 29 October 2026.

The broader collection includes readable conventional academic pages; the shortlist highlights stronger visual ideas. The review covers desktop appearance and content, rather than a full mobile or accessibility audit of every external site. Read the audit notes.

All website designs and content belong to their respective authors. Saved stars stay in this browser. The preview gallery works offline; external sites and repositories require an internet connection.
